description: Full-text search across all Data360 indicators (every WDI/IMF/WHO/ILO/education series in one index). Returns indicator codes (use as INDICATOR in data360_get_data), names, owning DATABASE_ID/name, units, and definitions. Optionally restrict to one database with database_id.

database_id.description: Optional: restrict to one source database, e.g. "WB_WDI" or "IMF_BOP" (from data360_list_databases).

query.description: Keyword(s), e.g. "GDP per capita" or "maternal mortality". Use "*" for all.

name: data360_search_indicators
title: Data360 Search Indicators
